An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the initialize method of the AMDRadeonX4000_AMDAccelSharedUserClient class. title: Apple macOS AMDRadeonX4000_AMDAccelResource initialize Out-Of-Bounds Read Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Apple MacOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the initialize method of the AMDRadeonX4000_AMDAccelSharedUserClient class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges to the level of the kernel.
